boolean;\n    readonly onConnect: () => Promise<void>;\n}) {\n    return (\n        <main className=\"flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-[#07151d] px-6 text-slate-200\">\n            <div className=\"max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] p-8 text-center shadow-2xl\">\n                <h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-white\">Diskuze projektu je pro členy komunity</h1>\n                <p className=\"mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-400\">\n                    {errorMessage ?? 'Ověřujeme vaše připojení do komunity.'}\n                </p>\n                <div className=\"mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3\">\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        onClick={() => void onConnect()}\n                        disabled={isConnecting}\n                        className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-300 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-950 hover:bg-cyan-200 disabled:opacity-60\"\n                    >\n                        {isConnecting ? <LoaderCircle className=\"h-4 w-4 animate-spin\" /> : <RefreshCw className=\"h-4 w-4\" />}\n                        Ověřit připojení\n                    </button>\n                    <Link\n                        href={COMMUNITY_PATH}\n                        className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/15 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 hover:bg-white/10\"\n                    >\n                        <ArrowLeft className=\"h-4 w-4\" /> Otevřít komunitu\n                    </Link>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n        </main>\n    );\n}\n\n/**\n * Project discussions bootstrap their own narrowly scoped workshop session from the member's community session, then\n * hand off to the proven workshop participant room. The author record created with the project is already a moderator\n * of that room, so the normal chat moderation UI needs no special project branch.\n */\nexport function CommunityProjectDiscussionPage({ project }: CommunityProjectDiscussionPageProps) {\n    const [isConnecting, setIsConnecting] = useState(true);\n    const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);\n    const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n    const [sessionVersion, setSessionVersion] = useState(0);\n\n    const connect = useCallback(async () => {\n        setIsConnecting(true);\n        setErrorMessage(null);\n        try {\n            await connectToCommunityProjectDiscussion(project.id);\n            setIsConnected(true);\n            setSessionVersion((currentVersion) => currentVersion + 1);\n        } catch {\n            setIsConnected(false);\n            setErrorMessage('Nejdřív se připojte do komunity. Potom se sem můžete vrátit a otevřít diskuzi projektu.');\n        } finally {\n            setIsConnecting(false);\n        }\n    }, [project.id]);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        void connect();\n    }, [connect]);\n\n    if (!isConnected) {\n        return <CommunityProjectDiscussionAccess errorMessage={errorMessage} isConnecting={isConnecting} onConnect={connect} />;\n    }\n\n    return (\n        <OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage\n            key={sessionVersion}\n            workshopSlug={project.discussionWorkshopSlug}\n            connectionDetails={{\n                title: project.title,\n                description: project.description,\n                dateLabel: 'Komunitní diskuze',\n                durationLabel: 'Přístup pro členy',\n                roomLabel: 'Projekt komunity',\n                connectionHeading: 'Připojit se do diskuze',\n                connectionDescription: 'Diskuze projektu navazuje na vaše připojení do komunity.',\n                submitLabel: 'Otevřít diskuzi',\n                language: 'cs',\n            }}\n            calendarDetails={null}\n            initialEmail=\"\"\n            initialFullname=\"\"\n            roomSubtitle=\"Projekt komunity · Promptbook\"\n            isWorkshopSelectionInUrl={false}\n            isMaterialsShown={false}\n            mainContentAfterWorkshopNavigation={<CommunityProjectDetailsPanel project={project} />}\n            connectionRequiredContent={\n                <CommunityProjectDiscussionAccess\n                    errorMessage=\"Připojení do diskuze vypršelo. Obnovíme ho podle vašeho členství v komunitě.\"\n                    isConnecting={isConnecting}\n                    onConnect={connect}\n                />\n            }\n            unavailableConnectionMessage=\"Diskuze projektu se nepodařila načíst.\"\n        />\n    );\n}\n","numLines":121,"startLine":1,"totalLines":121}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01P2eGnPjMMoGEi3sdC3drXp","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport {\n2\t    getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames,\n3\t    getWorkshopKindCapabilities,\n4\t    isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom,\n5\t} from '@/lib/workshops/workshopKindCapabilities';\n6\timport { WORKSHOP_KIND_VALUES } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\n7\timport { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\n8\t\n9\tdescribe('workshop kind capabilities', () => {\n10\t    it('describes every room kind, so a kind added later cannot be left without an answer', () => {\n11\t        WORKSHOP_KIND_VALUES.forEach((workshopKind) => {\n12\t            expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopKind)).toBeDefined();\n13\t        });\n14\t    });\n15\t\n16\t    it('keeps a workshop occurrence the live event it always was', () => {\n17\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop')).toEqual({\n18\t            isSingleton: false,\n19\t            isSlugFixed: false,\n20\t            isScheduled: true,\n21\t            isEvent: true,\n22\t            isStageOffered: true,\n23\t            isRepositoryOffered: true,\n24\t            isPresentationOffered: true,\n25\t            isPollsOffered: false,\n26\t            isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: true,\n27\t            isMembershipOffered: true,\n28\t            isCommunityInvitationOffered: true,\n29\t            isDisconnectionOffered: true,\n30\t            isRealtime: true,\n31\t        });\n32\t    });\n33\t\n34\t    it('makes the community one calm permanent room without a schedule, a stage, or live updates', () => {\n35\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('community')).toEqual({\n36\t            isSingleton: true,\n37\t            isSlugFixed: true,\n38\t            isScheduled: false,\n39\t            isEvent: false,\n40\t            isStageOffered: false,\n41\t            isRepositoryOffered: false,\n42\t            isPresentationOffered: false,\n43\t            isPollsOffered: true,\n44\t            isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: false,\n45\t            isMembershipOffered: true,\n46\t            isCommunityInvitationOffered: false,\n47\t            isDisconnectionOffered: true,\n48\t            isRealtime: false,\n49\t        });\n50\t    });\n51\t\n52\t    it('makes every project a calm discussion room with its address controlled by the project record', () => {\n53\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('project')).toEqual({\n54\t            isSingleton: false,\n55\t            isSlugFixed: true,\n56\t            isScheduled: false,\n57\t            isEvent: false,\n58\t            isStageOffered: false,\n59\t            isRepositoryOffered: false,\n60\t            isPresentationOffered: false,\n61\t            isPollsOffered: false,\n62\t            isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: false,\n63\t            isMembershipOffered: false,\n64\t            isCommunityInvitationOffered: false,\n65\t            isDisconnectionOffered: false,\n66\t            isRealtime: false,\n67\t        });\n68\t    });\n69\t\n70\t    it('shows a community poll in its owner and in workshop occurrences it can be attached to', () => {\n71\t        expect(isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom('community')).toBe(true);\n72\t        expect(isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom('workshop')).toBe(true);\n73\t        expect(isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom('project')).toBe(false);\n74\t    });\n75\t\n76\t    it('offers the membership of the community wherever a member is connected under their own address', () => {\n77\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('community').isMembershipOffered).toBe(true);\n78\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop').isMembershipOffered).toBe(true);\n79\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('project').isMembershipOffered).toBe(false);\n80\t    });\n81\t\n82\t    it('leads into the community from the rooms which are reached without it', () => {\n83\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop').isCommunityInvitationOffered).toBe(true);\n84\t        // The community never invites anybody into itself, and a project discussion is opened from the community.\n85\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('community').isCommunityInvitationOffered).toBe(false);\n86\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('project').isCommunityInvitationOffered).toBe(false);\n87\t    });\n88\t\n89\t    it('lets a participant sign out of the rooms they connected to themselves', () => {\n90\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop').isDisconnectionOffered).toBe(true);\n91\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('community').isDisconnectionOffered).toBe(true);\n92\t        // A project discussion is opened with the community session, which is where its member signs out instead.\n93\t        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('project').isDisconnectionOffered).toBe(false);\n94\t    });\n95\t\n96\t    it('refuses a schedule, a stage, a project, and an address written into a room which has none of them', () => {\n97\t        expect(\n98\t            getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames('community', {\n99\t                slug: 'jina-komunita',\n100\t                startsAt: '2026-08-21T19:00:00+02:00',\n101\t                endsAt: null,\n102\t                youtubeVideoId: 'dQw4w9WgXcQ',\n103\t                recordingStartOffsetSeconds: 75,\n104\t                previewYoutubeVideoId: 'M7lc1UVf-VE',\n105\t                presentationUrl: 'https://files.example.com/workshop.pdf',\n106\t                repository: { owner: 'hejny', name: 'promptbook', branch: {\n    getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames,\n    getWorkshopKindCapabilities,\n    isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom,\n} from '@/lib/workshops/workshopKindCapabilities';\nimport { WORKSHOP_KIND_VALUES } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\nimport { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\n\ndescribe('workshop kind capabilities', () => {\n    it('describes every room kind, so a kind added later cannot be left without an answer', () => {\n        WORKSHOP_KIND_VALUES.forEach((workshopKind) => {\n            expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopKind)).toBeDefined();\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('keeps a workshop occurrence the live event it always was', () => {\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop')).toEqual({\n            isSingleton: false,\n            isSlugFixed: false,\n            isScheduled: true,\n            isEvent: true,\n            isStageOffered: true,\n            isRepositoryOffered: true,\n            isPresentationOffered: true,\n            isPollsOffered: false,\n            isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: true,\n            isMembershipOffered: true,\n            isCommunityInvitationOffered: true,\n            isDisconnectionOffered: true,\n            isRealtime: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('makes the community one calm permanent room without a schedule, a stage, or live updates', () => {\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('community')).toEqual({\n            isSingleton: true,\n            isSlugFixed: true,\n            isScheduled: false,\n            isEvent: false,\n            isStageOffered: false,\n            isRepositoryOffered: false,\n            isPresentationOffered: false,\n            isPollsOffered: true,\n            isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: false,\n            isMembershipOffered: true,\n            isCommunityInvitationOffered: false,\n            isDisconnectionOffered: true,\n            isRealtime: false,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('makes every project a calm discussion room with its address controlled by the project record', () => {\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('project')).toEqual({\n            isSingleton: false,\n            isSlugFixed: true,\n            isScheduled: false,\n            isEvent: false,\n            isStageOffered: false,\n            isRepositoryOffered: false,\n            isPresentationOffered: false,\n            isPollsOffered: false,\n            isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: false,\n            isMembershipOffered: false,\n            isCommunityInvitationOffered: false,\n            isDisconnectionOffered: false,\n            isRealtime: false,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('shows a community poll in its owner and in workshop occurrences it can be attached to', () => {\n        expect(isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom('community')).toBe(true);\n        expect(isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom('workshop')).toBe(true);\n        expect(isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom('project')).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('offers the membership of the community wherever a member is connected under their own address', () => {\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('community').isMembershipOffered).toBe(true);\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop').isMembershipOffered).toBe(true);\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('project').isMembershipOffered).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('leads into the community from the rooms which are reached without it', () => {\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop').isCommunityInvitationOffered).toBe(true);\n        // The community never invites anybody into itself, and a project discussion is opened from the community.\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('community').isCommunityInvitationOffered).toBe(false);\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('project').isCommunityInvitationOffered).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('lets a participant sign out of the rooms they connected to themselves', () => {\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop').isDisconnectionOffered).toBe(true);\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('community').isDisconnectionOffered).toBe(true);\n        // A project discussion is opened with the community session, which is where its member signs out instead.\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('project').isDisconnectionOffered).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('refuses a schedule, a stage, a project, and an address written into a room which has none of them', () => {\n        expect(\n            getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames('community', {\n                slug: 'jina-komunita',\n                startsAt: '2026-08-21T19:00:00+02:00',\n                endsAt: null,\n                youtubeVideoId: 'dQw4w9WgXcQ',\n                recordingStartOffsetSeconds: 75,\n                previewYoutubeVideoId: 'M7lc1UVf-VE',\n                presentationUrl: 'https://files.example.com/workshop.pdf',\n                repository: { owner: 'hejny', name: 'promptbook', branch: null, deploymentUrl: null },\n            }),\n        ).toEqual([\n            'startsAt',\n            'endsAt',\n            'youtubeVideoId',\n occurrence be about a project, because that is what it is held about', () => {\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop').isRepositoryOffered).toBe(true);\n        expect(getWorkshopKindCapabilities('workshop').isPresentationOffered).toBe(true);\n        expect(\n            getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames('workshop', {\n                repository: { owner: it('refuses the fields of an event written into a room which is no event at all', () => {\n        expect(\n            getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames('community', {\n                eventType: expect(getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames('workshop', { slug: 'produkcni-kod-2026-09-10' })).toEqual([]);\n    });\n\n    it('leaves every other change of a room alone, whatever its kind', () => {\n        expect(getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames('community', { title: 'Komunita Promptbooku' })).toEqual([]);\n        expect(getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames('community', { startsAt: undefined vi } from 'vitest';\n\nconst POLL: WorkshopPoll = {\n    id: 'poll-1',\n    question: 'Kterému tématu se máme věnovat?',\n    isClosed: false,\n    isVisible: true,\n    isOtherOptionEnabled: false,\n    createdAt: '2026-08-24T10:00:00.000Z',\n    updatedAt: '2026-08-24T10:00:00.000Z',\n    options: [\n        { id: 'option-1', label: 'Testování', sortOrder: 0, voteCount: 3, isVotedByParticipant: {\n    id: 'workshop-1',\n    kind: 'workshop',\n    slug: 'zari',\n    title: 'Zářijový workshop',\n    description: 'Zářijový termín online workshopu.',\n    startsAt: '2026-09-10T16:00:00.000Z',\n    endsAt: null,\n    isPublished: true,\n    event: DEFAULT_EVENT_DETAILS,\n};\n\nafterEach(cleanup);\n\ndescribe('community polls', () => {\n    it('shows only aggregate results and lets a member change their own choice', async () => {\n        const onVote = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true);\n        render(<WorkshopPolls polls={[POLL]} isInteractionBanned={false} onVote={onVote} />);\n\n        expect(screen.getByText('Kterému tématu se máme věnovat?')).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Testování/ }).getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true');\n        expect(screen.getByText('3 · 75 %')).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.getByText('1 · 25 %')).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.queryByText('Anketa komunity')).toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.queryByText('4 hlasů')).toBeNull();\n        expect(\n            screen.queryByText(\n                'Vyberte jednu možnost. Stejný hlas uvidíte v komunitě i v připojených workshopech a můžete jej kdykoli změnit.',\n            ),\n        ).toBeNull();\n\n        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Nasazování/ }));\n\n        await waitFor(() => expect(onVote).toHaveBeenCalledWith('poll-1', { optionId: 'option-2' }));\n    });\n\n    it('keeps the result readable but disables a closed poll and a banned member', () => {\n        const onVote = vi.fn();\n        const { rerender } = render(<WorkshopPolls polls={[{ ...POLL, isClosed: true }]} isInteractionBanned={false} onVote={onVote} />);\n\n        expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Testování/ }).hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(true);\n        expect(screen.queryByText('Hlasování skončilo')).toBeNull();\n\n        rerender(<WorkshopPolls polls={[POLL]} isInteractionBanned={true} onVote={onVote} />);\n\n        expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Nasazování/ }).hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(true);\n        expect(screen.getByText('Pro tento účet nejsou interakce dostupné.')).not.toBeNull();\n    });\n\n    it('lets an attached workshop cast the same shared community vote', async () => {\n        const věnovat?')).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Testování/ }).hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(false);\n\n        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: and clears the field after saving', async () => {\n        const onVote = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true);\n        render(\n            <WorkshopPolls\n                polls={[{ ...POLL, isOtherOptionEnabled: true }]}\n                isInteractionBanned={false}\n                onVote={onVote}\n            />,\n        );\n\n        const otherOptionInput = screen.getByLabelText('Jiná odpověď');\n        fireEvent.change(otherOptionInput, { target: { value: ' Bezpečnost ' } });\n        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat a hlasovat' }));\n\n        await waitFor(() =>\n            expect(onVote).toHaveBeenCalledWith('poll-1', { otherOptionLabel: 'Bezpečnost' }),\n        );\n        await waitFor(() => expect((otherOptionInput as HTMLInputElement).value).toBe(''));\n    });\n\n    it('does not show badges for the poll occurrences it is attached to', () => {\n        render(\n            <WorkshopPolls\n                polls={[{ ...POLL, attachedWorkshops: [ATTACHED_WORKSHOP] }]}\n                isInteractionBanned={false}\n                onVote={vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true)}\n            />,\n        );\n\n        expect(screen.queryByText('Zářijový workshop')).toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.queryByRole('list', { name: 'Týká se workshopů' })).toBeNull();\n    });\n});\n","numLines":120,"startLine":1,"totalLines":120}}}

WorkshopPoll[];\n    readonly isInteractionBanned: boolean;\n    /**\n     * Records the one e-mail-owned vote shared by the community and every workshop occurrence the poll is attached to.\n     */\n    readonly onVote?: (pollId: string, voteValues: WorkshopPollVoteValues) => Promise<boolean>;\n};\n\n/**\n * The member-facing side of a room poll. It accepts only the aggregated poll state, therefore it cannot accidentally\n * reveal who voted for an option; a member knows solely whether the highlighted choice is their own, whichever room\n * they used to make it.\n */\nexport function WorkshopPolls({\n    polls,\n    isInteractionBanned,\n    onVote,\n}: WorkshopPollsProps) {\n    const [votingPollId, setVotingPollId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n    const [otherOptionLabels, setOtherOptionLabels] = useState<Readonly<Record<string, string>>>({});\n\n    if (polls.length === 0) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    const handleVote = async (pollId: string, voteValues: WorkshopPollVoteValues): Promise<boolean> => {\n        if (onVote === undefined) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        setVotingPollId(pollId);\n        try {\n            return await onVote(pollId, voteValues);\n        } finally {\n            setVotingPollId((currentPollId) => (currentPollId === pollId ? null : currentPollId));\n        }\n    };\n\n    const handleOtherOptionSubmit = async (\n        event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,\n        pollId: string,\n        isVoteAvailable: boolean,\n    ) => {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        const otherOptionLabel = (otherOptionLabels[pollId] ?? '').trim();\n        if (!isVoteAvailable || otherOptionLabel === '') {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const isVoteSaved = await handleVote(pollId, { otherOptionLabel });\n        if (isVoteSaved) {\n            setOtherOptionLabels((currentLabels) => ({ ...currentLabels, [pollId]: '' }));\n        }\n    };\n\n    return (\n        <section aria-label=\"Ankety komunity\" className=\"space-y-4\">\n            {polls.map((poll) => {\n                const totalVoteCount = getWorkshopPollVoteCount(poll);\n                const isVoting = votingPollId === poll.id;\n                const isVotingInCurrentRoomEnabled = onVote !== undefined;\n                const isVoteAvailable = isVotingInCurrentRoomEnabled && !poll.isClosed && !isInteractionBanned;\n                const otherOptionLabel = otherOptionLabels[poll.id] ?? '';\n                const isOtherOptionLabelWritten = otherOptionLabel.trim() !== '';\n                const interactionAvailabilityMessage = !isVotingInCurrentRoomEnabled\n                    ? 'Hlasování v této místnosti není dostupné.'\n                    : isInteractionBanned\n                      ? 'Pro tento účet nejsou interakce dostupné.'\n                      : null;\n\n                return (\n                    <article\n                        key={poll.id}\n                        className=\"overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-cyan-300/20 bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-300/[0.10] to-slate-950/20 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-950/10\"\n                    >\n                        <div className=\"border-b border-white/[0.08] px-5 py-4\">\n                            <h2 className=\"text-lg font-bold leading-6 text-white\">{poll.question}</h2>\n                        </div>\n\n                        <div className=\"space-y-2.5 p-4\">\n                            {poll.options.map((option) => {\n                                const percentage = getWorkshopPollOptionVotePercentage(option, totalVoteCount);\n                                const isSelected = option.isVotedByParticipant;\n\n                                return (\n                                    <Button\n                                        key={option.id}\n                                        type=\"button\"\n                                        variant=\"ghost\"\n                                        disabled={!isVoteAvailable || isVoting}\n                                        aria-pressed={isSelected}\n                                        onClick={() => void handleVote(poll.id, { optionId: option.id })}\n                                        className={`relative flex h-auto w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-left transition ${\n                                            isSelected\n                                                ? 'border-cyan-300/80 bg-cyan-300/[0.17] text-white hover:bg-cyan-300/[0.20]'\n                                                : 'border-white/[0.10] bg-slate-950/30 text-slate-100 hover:border-cyan-300/35 hover:bg-white/[0.07]'\n                                        }`}\n                                    >\n                                        <span\n                                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                                            className={`absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-cyan-300/[0.10] transition-[width] ${\n                                                isSelected ? 'bg-cyan-300/[0.20]' : ''\n                                            }`}\n                                            style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}\n                                        />\n                                        <span className=\"relative flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3\">\n                                            <span\n                                                className={`flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border ${\n                                                    isSelected\n                                                        ? 'border-cyan-200 bg-cyan-300 text-slate-950'\n                                                        : 'border-slate-500 text-transparent'\n                                                }`}\n                                            >\n                                                <Check className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\n                                            </span>\n                                            <span className=\"min-w-0 flex-1 break-words font-medium\">{option.label}</span>\n                                            <span className=\"shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-300\">\n                                                {option.voteCount} · {percentage} %\n                                            </span>\n                                        </span>\n                                    </Button>\n                                );\n                            })}\n\n                            {poll.isOtherOptionEnabled && (\n                                <form\n                                    className=\"mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-cyan-300/35 bg-slate-950/20 p-3\"\n                                    onSubmit={(event) => void handleOtherOptionSubmit(event, poll.id, isVoteAvailable)}\n                                >\n                                    <label\n                                        className=\"block text-sm font-medium text-slate-100\"\n                                        htmlFor={`poll-${poll.id}-other-option`}\n                                    >\n                                        Jiná odpověď\n                                    </label>\n                                    <div className=\"mt-2 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row\">\n                                        <Input\n                                            id={`poll-${poll.id}-other-option`}\n                                            value={otherOptionLabel}\n                                            onChange={(event) =>\n                                                setOtherOptionLabels((currentLabels) => ({\n                                                    ...currentLabels,\n                                                    [poll.id]: event.target.value,\n                                                }))\n                                            }\n                                            disabled={!isVoteAvailable || isVoting}\n                                            maxLength={200}\n                                            placeholder=\"Napište vlastní odpověď\"\n                                            className=\"border-white/[0.14] bg-slate-950/40 text-white placeholder:text-slate-400\"\n                                        />\n                                        <Button\n                                            type=\"submit\"\n                                            disabled={!isVoteAvailable || isVoting || !isOtherOptionLabelWritten}\n                                            className=\"shrink-0\"\n                                        >\n                                            Přidat a hlasovat\n                                        </Button>\n                                    </div>\n                                    <p className=\"mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-400\">\n                                        Vaše odpověď se přidá mezi možnosti a zároveň pro ni odevzdáte svůj hlas.\n                                    </p>\n                                </form>\n                            )}\n                        </div>\n\n                        {!poll.isClosed && interactionAvailabilityMessage !== null && (\n                            <p className=\"px-5 pb-4 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-400\">{interactionAvailabilityMessage}</p>\n                        )}\n                    </article>\n                );\n            })}\n        </section>\n    );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":2,"oldLines":12,"newStart":2,"newLines":17,"lines":[" "," import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';"," import { Input } from 'border-cyan-300/80 bg-cyan-300/[0.17] text-white hover:bg-cyan-300/[0.20]'\n                                                : 'border-white/[0.10] bg-slate-950/30 text-slate-100 hover:border-cyan-300/35 hover:bg-white/[0.07]'\n                                        }`}\n                                    >\n                                        <span\n                                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                                            className={`absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-cyan-300/[0.10] transition-[width] ${\n                                                isSelected ? 'bg-cyan-300/[0.20]' : ''\n                                            }`}\n                                            style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}\n                                        />\n                                        <span className=\"relative flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3\">\n                                            <span\n                                                className={`flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border ${\n                                                    isSelected\n                                                        ? 'border-cyan-200 bg-cyan-300 text-slate-950'\n                                                        : 'border-slate-500 text-transparent'\n                                                }`}\n                                            >\n                                                <Check className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\n                                            </span>\n                                            <span className=\"min-w-0 flex-1 break-words font-medium\">{option.label}</span>\n                                            <span className=\"shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-300\">\n                                                {option.voteCount} · {percentage} %\n                                            </span>\n                                        </span>\n                                    </Button>\n                                );\n                            })}\n\n                            {poll.isOtherOptionEnabled && (\n                                <form\n                                    className=\"mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-cyan-300/35 bg-slate-950/20 p-3\"\n                                    onSubmit={(event) => void handleOtherOptionSubmit(event, poll.id, isVoteAvailable)}\n                                >\n                                    <label\n isPurchaseOffered: false,\n    isSubscriptionManagementOffered: true,\n};\n\n/**\n * The paid materials of a room as far as a member who has not paid is told about them\n */\nconst PAID_MEMBERS_ONLY_CONTENT_PREVIEWS: readonly WorkshopContentPreview[] = [\n    { id: 'paid-material-1', title: 'Bonusové podklady' },\n];\n\n/**\n * An occurrence which is already over by the moment the room is rendered at, so its stage is the closing wrap-up\n *\n * Note: Its stream is deliberately absent, exactly as the server hands the room to a member whose membership does not\n *       unlock the recording of it.\n */\nconst ENDED_WORKSHOP_WITHOUT_ITS_RECORDING: WorkshopDetails = {\n    ...WORKSHOP,\n    endsAt: '2026-08-21T19:10:00+02:00',\n    youtubeVideoId: null,\n};\n\n/**\n * owner: 'hejny',\n        name: 'promptbook',\n        branch: 'main',\n        deploymentUrl: 'https://workshop.example/app',\n    },\n};\n\nconst WORKSHOP_WITH_PRESENTATION: WorkshopDetails = {\n []);\n}\n\n/**\n * Where among those cards the way into the permanent community is offered\n */\nfunction getCommunityMaterialIndex(materialCards: readonly Element[]): number {\n    const {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011Cf6z4TMsWbnK6jHGQpQzS","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01LWNqFKYViJwNFwY1FR74Ce","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\workshops\\workshopPollPlacement.test.ts","content":"import { getWorkshopPollPlacement } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopPollPlacement';\nimport { WORKSHOP_KIND_VALUES } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\nimport { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\n\ndescribe('workshop poll placement', () => {\n    it('opens the room which owns its polls with them, because that is where its decisions are made', () => {\n        expect(getWorkshopPollPlacement('community')).toBe('before-materials');\n    });\n\n    it('closes a workshop occurrence with the polls it is only the subject of', () => {\n        expect(getWorkshopPollPlacement('workshop')).toBe('after-materials');\n    });\n\n    it('places the polls of every room kind, so a kind added later cannot be left without an answer', () => {\n        WORKSHOP_KIND_VALUES.forEach((workshopKind) => {\n            expect(['before-materials', 'after-materials']).toContain(getWorkshopPollPlacement(workshopKind));\n        });\n    });\n});\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1214,"cache_read_input_tokens":138158,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1214},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"74733643-f02b-4d3b-89ed-839271cd8e35","uuid":"3b30119f-5771-4534-859c-2ff7a4622a21","timestamp":"2026-09-16T10:46:35.560Z","request_id":"req_011Cf6z4Sr82Zmj4PLQdK8Pf"}
